machine.glRenderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M3 Max, Unspecified Version)

medianMs.stat: median frame after the first, drawLayers + bakes + render + gl.finish

liveDraws.stat: frames after the first that drew the layer live

baked.stat: tiles baked after the first frame

bakeMs.stat: median CPU bake time of a frame that baked

firstMs.stat: the first frame, which builds the scene's visibility index

walkMs.stat: most a frame spent walking the layer for bakes

submitMs.stat: most a frame spent in the renderer drawing bakes

releaseMs.stat: most a frame spent freeing tiles

peakBytes.stat: most GPU memory the tiles held
